product_overview: FireWatch is a comprehensive full-stack forest fire monitoring and response system that integrates citizen-submitted reports, area risk intelligence, and live weather data to provide timely alerts and help fire response teams and citizens stay ahead of fast-moving wildfires.
core_goals: Enable timely and accurate reporting of forest fire incidents by users.
Provide administrators tools to monitor, manage, and analyze fire risk across multiple forest areas.
Support role-based access control with secure authentication for users and admins.
Integrate real-time weather data and fire prediction systems to enhance situational awareness and response readiness.
Visualize fire risk zones and alerts on interactive maps for both users and admins.
Facilitate effective communication and alerting through notifications to prevent wildfire damage and protect communities.
key_features: Secure user registration and login with role-based access control (User and Admin).
User dashboard displaying fire risk level, current weather data, interactive map, and manual fire alert submission with image and GPS location.
Admin dashboard with full access to manage alerts, monitored forest areas, fire prediction settings, and data analysis.
CRUD functionality for forest area management including assigning risk levels and visualizing areas with color-coded maps.
Fire alert system supporting manual user alerts and automatic alerts triggered by the prediction system, with notifications for high-risk events.
Integration of weather monitoring per area with potential external API data sources, displayed in dashboards.
Map visualization with color-coded risk zones (green, orange, red), clickable areas for detailed information.
Comprehensive data analysis tools showing charts and tables of humidity, temperature, risk levels, and trends.
Real-time or scheduled alert notifications for both administrators and users to ensure prompt awareness.
Mobile application with core features for login, dashboard viewing, alert submission, and GPS-enabled map support.
user_flow_summary: Users register and login securely, accessing their dashboard showing current fire risk and weather data.
Users can view an interactive map with fire risk zones and submit manual fire alerts with images and GPS data.
Admins login to access the admin dashboard with capabilities to view all alerts, manage forest areas, and configure fire prediction settings.
Admins perform CRUD operations on forest areas, assign risk levels, and update weather data per area.
The fire prediction system runs and can be toggled on/off by admins to generate automatic alerts in addition to manual reports.
Both users and admins receive real-time or scheduled notifications about fire risk changes and alerts.
Data analysis pages enable admins to visualize and understand fire trends and risk levels over time for better decision making.
Mobile app users can perform core actions like login, viewing dashboards, submitting alerts, and accessing maps with GPS support.
validation_criteria: User registration, login, logout, and role-based access control functioning correctly and securely.
Users can submit manual fire alerts with geo-tagging and images, and those alerts are stored and displayed properly.
Admins can create, update, delete forest areas and assign risk levels, reflected on the map with correct color coding.
Fire prediction settings can be viewed and toggled by admins, and automatic alerts are generated accordingly.
Weather data per area is displayed accurately and can be updated by admins.
Maps show accurate locations of areas and alerts, with interactive and color-coded zones.
Data analysis displays accurate charts and trends, reflecting the underlying data.
Notifications are sent correctly in real-time or scheduled intervals to intended recipients.
Mobile app features align with the web app capabilities including authentication, dashboard, alerts, and mapping with GPS.
All API endpoints enforce authentication and role-based authorization consistently.
